decisions.reason: As a flagship click-in adapter highlighted on the home page and closely tied to the firm’s modular premium lighting direction, it is likely to remain in the range unless replaced by a direct successor.
A multi-model LED luminaire line fits the firm’s core interior lighting business and a growing market, so it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn despite limited later website evidence.
The home automation server box matches the firm’s control-and-comfort strategy, but control hardware faces faster technical turnover than luminaires, making discontinuation somewhat more plausible.
A luminaire family presented on its own page sits squarely within the firm’s established premium offering, so absent signs of failure it would usually stay on the market for several years.
